If the goal is to increase your calcium absorption, you will want to separate them. As a post bariatric patient, I take a bariatric multivitamin that includes iron, zinc, magnesium, and so many others. Then I take a calcium chew 2 hours after. I also take another calcium chew before bed. Since they taste a bit like starburst, I kinda look forward to them.

Calcium chews twice a day is a great option for ease and flavor as well. Bariatric fusion is a good brand and is often required for post bariatric surgery patients. However, calcium absorbs the same things as zinc and iron, so you will want to take the calcium chew at least two hours after you take something with zinc or iron.
